items.title: In the Frame: Into the Water
items.excerpt: This edition of our photography prompt series is all about action. It's the height of summer and we know what this means – swimsuits on, sun high up, heads underwater. We dare our Community to shoot the wackiest of beach or pool shots, and capture the season at its liveliest!

items.title: Solo Wedding Project: Bird (Film Full Photo) Captures Self-Love with the Lomomatic 110
items.excerpt: - ### [Solo Wedding Project: Bird (Film Full Photo) Captures Self-Love with the Lomomatic 110](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358753-solo-wedding-project-bird-film-full-photo-captures-self-love-with-the-lomomatic-110) Thai photographer Bird, also known as Film Full Photo, uses the Lomomatic 110 to bring her Solo Wedding concept to life – a personal project created to share the idea that “Happiness doesn't depend on someone else – it begins with ourselves.”

items.title: First Impressions: Tree's Thailand Travel Snapshots with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera
items.excerpt: - ### [First Impressions: Tree's Thailand Travel Snapshots with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358992-first-impressions-tree-s-travel-snapshots-with-the-half-frame-simple-use-reloadable-film-camera) We handed the new Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Classicolor to Tree, inviting her to document her travels across Thailand. After her trip, we talked about the journey, the camera, and how film keeps memories fresh.

items.title: The Soft and the Strong: Rebeca Morimoto and Her Customized La Sardina Camera & Flash DIY
items.excerpt: - ### [The Soft and the Strong: Rebeca Morimoto and Her Customized La Sardina Camera & Flash DIY](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358848-the-soft-and-the-strong-rebeca-morimoto-and-her-customized-la-sardina-camera-flash-diy) Big applause for the La Sardina by Rebeca Morimoto! The Peruvian Japanese illustrator brings her iconic style to this unique, customizable camera, giving La Sardina the punk, tattooed makeover she always deserved.

items.title: Clubhouse Paradiso Capture Scotland’s World Cup in Boston on the ActionSampler
items.excerpt: - ### [Clubhouse Paradiso Capture Scotland’s World Cup in Boston on the ActionSampler](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358935-clubhouse-paradiso-capture-scotland-s-world-cup-in-boston-on-the-actionsampler) 2026-07-27 The World Cup fever isn't over! We take a look at Ralph McClure and Keir Reid of Clubhouse Paradiso's visit to Boston for Scotland’s World Cup campaign, where the Glasgow-based duo created some stop animations of the events using the ActionSampler.

items.title: Dreamy Portraits & Vibrant Colors: Riccardo Montanini with the LomoChrome Classicolor 35 mm ISO 200
items.excerpt: - ### [Dreamy Portraits & Vibrant Colors: Riccardo Montanini with the LomoChrome Classicolor 35 mm ISO 200](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358741-dreamy-portraits-vibrant-colors-riccardo-montanini-with-the-lomochrome-classicolor-35-mm-iso-200) Riccardo Montanini puts the new LomoChrome Classicolor ISO 200 to the test by capturing two contrasting worlds in a dual-themed portrait series, shot with the Petzval lens. Find out his first impressions in this interview.

items.title: Recap: London Graphic Centre LomoWalk
items.excerpt: - ### [Recap: London Graphic Centre LomoWalk](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358671-recap-london-graphic-centre-lomowalk) 2026-07-26 We teamed up with London Graphic Centre for another fun-packed LomoApparat LomoWalk around Covent Garden and Soho using a mix of Lomography films.

items.title: Pride Parade Moments with the Lomography Half-Frame Simple Use Camera
items.excerpt: - ### [Pride Parade Moments with the Lomography Half-Frame Simple Use Camera](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358922-pride-parade-moments-with-the-lomography-half-frame-simple-use-camera) This year's Pride month, Lomography staff from across the globe attended Pride parades organized by their respective local communities, and capturing with them scenes of solidarity was the new Half-Frame Simple Use Camera, pre-loaded with Classicolor 200.

items.title: Whispers of the Summer Forest: Videographer Jihu Kim’s Dreamlike Imagery with the Joseph Petzval 27 mm f/1.7
items.excerpt: - ### [Whispers of the Summer Forest: Videographer Jihu Kim’s Dreamlike Imagery with the Joseph Petzval 27 mm f/1.7](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358819-whispers-of-the-summer-forest-videographer-jihu-kim-s-dreamlike-imagery-with-the-joseph-petzval-27-mm-f-1-7) Jihu Kim headed into the forest with the Joseph Petzval 27 mm f/1.7 Focus-Coupled Art Lens to capture dreamlike scenes. Using the lens’s unique swirly bokeh and immersive wide-angle perspective, he beautifully translated the feeling of being drawn into nature.

items.title: Film Photography in Tune with Music: Meet Argenteurs
items.excerpt: - ### [Film Photography in Tune with Music: Meet Argenteurs](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358781-film-photography-in-tune-with-music-meet-argenteurs) 2026-07-24 From the Lomo MC-A on stage to the Lomography Color Negative ISO 400 film for a single cover, Argenteurs takes us behind the scenes of their analogue photography practice, using film to bring artists’ worlds to life and create lasting images.

items.title: Analogue Journal: Printing Memories with Artist Cat Caldarola (@talllcatart)
items.excerpt: - ### [Analogue Journal: Printing Memories with Artist Cat Caldarola (@talllcatart)](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358900-analogue-journal-printing-memories-with-artist-cat-caldarola-talllcatart) Brooklyn-based artist Cat Caldarola shares how instant photography, journaling, and printmaking come together to preserve memories and inspire their creative practice.

items.title: Analogue Meets Subway Systems: Dami1992 Shooting on Colour Negative Film
items.excerpt: - ### [Analogue Meets Subway Systems: Dami1992 Shooting on Colour Negative Film](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358800-analogue-meets-subway-systems-dami1992-shooting-colour-negative-film) In this interview, David, a Czech photographer, introduces his fascination with metro stations and other liminal spaces. He also shares his experience working with Lomography Color Negative film, and offers advice on street photography.

items.title: First Rolls with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: Lomography Manila
items.excerpt: - ### [First Rolls with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: Lomography Manila](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358738-first-rolls-with-the-half-frame-simple-use-reloadable-film-camera-lomography-manila) Get a glimpse of the Lomography Manila team's first adventure with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera.

items.title: LomoWalk Recap: A City Color Experiment with Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: - ### [LomoWalk Recap: A City Color Experiment with Lomo MC-A](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358769-lomowalk-recap-a-city-color-experiment-with-lomo-mc-a) We're used to Shanghai's skyline of towering skyscrapers – and to overthinking every shot before pressing the shutter. But this time, we flipped the script. We set out with a simple task: pick a color, wander, and let the city speak for itself on film.

items.title: Nicole Tecchio's Analogue Journal: A Visual Diary of an Illustrator's “Casa Vacanze”
items.excerpt: - ### [Nicole Tecchio's Analogue Journal: A Visual Diary of an Illustrator's “Casa Vacanze”](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358815-nicole-tecchio-s-analogue-journal-visual-diary-of-an-illustrator-s-casa-vacanze) Take a look at Nicole Tecchio’s analogue journal where instant photography becomes a game of memory, imagination, and everyday storytelling.

items.title: Creators in Focus: How Images Evolve Through Lisa Brussell's Alternative Printing Processes
items.excerpt: - ### [Creators in Focus: How Images Evolve Through Lisa Brussell's Alternative Printing Processes](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358747-creators-in-focus-how-images-evolve-through-lisa-brussells-alternative-printing-processes) This edition of Creators in Focus features American artist Lisa Brussell, who combines different alternative printing processes to create richly layered frames.

items.title: In Depth: Raucously Red Film Rhapsodies
items.excerpt: - ### [In Depth: Raucously Red Film Rhapsodies](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358791-in-depth-raucously-red-film-rhapsodies) Inspired by the colors of the Community, I decided to spice things up a little. In this In Depth piece, I get into the history of the color red, from the caves to the big screen, from revolution to film rolls.

items.title: Behind the Scenes of “Stessa Direzione”: Paolo Santambrogio and the Music Video Shot with Joseph Petzval Art Lenses
items.excerpt: - ### [Behind the Scenes of “Stessa Direzione”: Paolo Santambrogio and the Music Video Shot with Joseph Petzval Art Lenses](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358779-behind-the-scenes-of-stessa-direzione-paolo-santambrogio-and-the-music-video-shot-with-joseph-petzval-art-lenses) Between Los Angeles and the Mojave Desert, photographer and filmmaker Paolo Santambrogio created the music video for Paola Iezzi's Stessa Direzione with the Joseph Petzval Lenses. We interviewed him to take a behind-the-scene look at a journey through cinema, memories, and visions.

items.title: First Impressions: Mateusz Zimnoch on Trying Out the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: - ### [First Impressions: Mateusz Zimnoch on Trying Out the Lomo MC-A](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358725-first-impressions-mateusz-zimnoch-on-trying-out-the-lomo-mc-a) From a childhood fascination with an old Zenit camera to trying out the Lomo MC-A, Mateusz has always stayed close to analogue photography. Dive into this interview to see how he puts this unique point-and-shoot to the test and captures the raw, nostalgic beauty of everyday moments.

items.title: A Day With RIKI: Lead Singer of Taiwanese Disco Band RIKI Lands in Japan with the Lomo'Instant Automat Glass
items.excerpt: - ### [A Day With RIKI: Lead Singer of Taiwanese Disco Band RIKI Lands in Japan with the Lomo'Instant Automat Glass](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358765-a-day-with-riki-lead-singer-of-taiwanese-disco-band-riki-lands-in-japan-with-the-lomo-instant-automat-glass) RIKI is an increasingly popular authentic Taiwanese disco band. We invited leader singer Riki to document his time traveling between music festivals with the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass.

items.title: Family History in 20,000 Found Negatives: Jon Olav Stokke on Becoming an Accidental Archivist
items.excerpt: - ### [Family History in 20,000 Found Negatives: Jon Olav Stokke on Becoming an Accidental Archivist](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358783-family-history-in-20-000-found-negatives-jon-olav-stokke-on-becoming-an-accidental-archivist) An unexpected treasure, obscured overseas travels, a meeting that should have happened earlier, and the last picnic no one knew would be the last recorded on film. Jon Olav Stokke’s family photography archive holds many such stories, recently rescued from a fate of gathering dust in the attic.

items.title: Lomography Tutorials: How To Reload Your Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera
items.excerpt: - ### [Lomography Tutorials: How To Reload Your Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358490-how-to-reload-your-half-frame-simple-use-reloadable-film-camera) Learn how to use the new Lomography Half-Frame Simple Use Reloadable Camera in this easy step-by-step tutorial.

items.excerpt: - ### [Meet the Half-Frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: The Social Cam for Everyday Analogue Adventures](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358797-meet-the-half-frame-simple-use-reloadable-film-camera-the-social-cam-for-everyday-analogue-adventures) There's a new kid in town. Introducing the Half-Frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera, the pocket-sized wonder you can bring anywhere and everywhere, to capture moments with no brakes and no pressure, all fun and half-frame whimsy!

items.title: Merging Human & Nature: Double Exposures at the analogueNOW Festival
items.excerpt: - ### [Merging Human & Nature: Double Exposures at the analogueNOW Festival](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358763-merging-human-nature-double-exposures-at-the-analoguenow-festival) Laetitia Heisler and Freia Fahrenholtz talk about the double exposure workshop at the analogueNOW festival early this year in Berlin, followed by the work and experiences of the participants.

items.title: Lomography Community Recap: June 2026
items.excerpt: - ### [Lomography Community Recap: June 2026](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358869-lomography-community-recap-june-2026) Here's your monthly dose of the latest happenings in the Lomography Community! Curious as to what your fellow Lomographers have been up to, or want the latest scoop on our ongoing Competitions? Find all this and more in our monthly recap!

items.title: A Day With Journalist Hanyu Deng and the Lomo'Instant Automat
items.excerpt: - ### [A Day With Journalist Hanyu Deng and the Lomo'Instant Automat](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358712-a-day-with-journalist-hanyu-deng-and-the-lomo-instant-automat) Hanyu Deng is a journalist, traveler, yoga enthusiast, and someone who still keeps a paper journal to slow her down when her mind won’t stop running. We asked her to spend a day with the Lomo’Instant Automat and share what came of it. Here’s her take.

items.title: James Trosh on Adding a Sprocket Rocket to His Arsenal
items.excerpt: - ### [James Trosh on Adding a Sprocket Rocket to His Arsenal](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358891-adding-a-sprocket-rocket-to-his-arsenal-with-james-trosh) 2026-07-12 Filmmaker James Trosh captured a historical moment with the Sprocket Rocket when UK football team Arsenal, also known as The Gunners, paraded through North London on an open-top bus to celebrate their Premier League title. He talked to us about this special moment immortalized on film.

items.title: Around the World in Analogue: Discovering the Charm of Japan
items.excerpt: - ### [Around the World in Analogue: Discovering the Charm of Japan](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358632-around-the-world-in-analogue-discovering-the-charm-of-japan) Stephen Hutchison (@stephenhutchison) returns in this edition of Around the World in Analogue, showing his two-week adventure across Japan through forty rolls of monochrome and color-shifting film.

items.title: When in Buenos Aires: The Corners of the Argentinian Capital with María Sol & Julián Garcia
items.excerpt: - ### [When in Buenos Aires: The Corners of the Argentinian Capital with María Sol & Julián Garcia](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358742-when-in-buenos-aires-the-corners-of-the-argentinian-capital-with-maria-sol-julian-garcia) Our new series invites shutterbugs to talk about their city – local culture, film and art scene, and more, starting with María (@mariamariasol) and Julián (@juliangarcia) from Buenos Aires.
